newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain to spend $2.39 bln on development projects.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain to spend $2.39 bln on development projects.

text.p: Bahrain has an ambitious 900 million dinar ($2.39 billion) plan to upgrade its infrastructure, a cabinet minister said on Monday.
Cabinet Affairs and Information Minister Mohammad Ibrahim al-Mutawae told Reuters the plan includes building a power plant at a cost of around $600 million to meet growing demand.
He said a number of Arab investment funds would finance a new sea port at a proposed industrial area in Hidd, which would be linked with the main sea port of Mina Sulman by a bridge.
"The participation of Arab funds in Bahrain's new projects reflects their confidence in its economy," Mutawae added.
He did not name the funds or give further details.
Four funds in Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia had earlier agreed to provide fellow Gulf Arab Bahrain with 26.6 million dinars in loans to expand its power distribution network.

Mutawae said that the island state was also studying a comprehensive tourism plan and had formed a ministerial committee to review future projects to boost economic growth and create jobs for Bahrainis.
